9.1 Workflow recap

In this chapter, we’re going to review the workflow that we’ve built so far and also discuss the concept of data leakage. To start, we’re going to walk through all of the code that’s necessary to recreate our workflow up to this point. The import block above has imported the three transformer classes we’re using, one modeling class, and two composition functions, and the polars datafame library. Next, define the columns we will select from the data, and read the training data to define X and y.
